author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 11 volume 2 (chapters 5-8) follows the 2023 science textbook: limits and derivatives split by textbook sections; new advanced lessons on permutations, combinations and three space-geometry lessons; probability and statistics points match the textbook; off-textbook lessons (complex numbers, space vectors, conditional probability, normal distribution) are marked as extra G12 content; G12 topics moved to G12 lessons; chapter exams fixed.
